peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (13.3): 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 32 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Initial resale-wave effect: 0 of the 9 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Oct 2024); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 999 yrs from 1878.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year over 23 months (Nov 2024–Sep 2026): higher than 31 of 258 similar developments. First resale wave from Nov 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 6 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 1.5.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lorong Chuan MRT about 1,810 m, Serangoon MRT about 1,810 m; closer than 5 of 462 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Zhonghua Primary School about 770 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 510 m), more than 383 of 462 similar developments (the same as 28); nearest hawker centre Chomp Chomp Food Centre about 440 m; nearest park Tavistock Ave Park about 440 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Serangoon North MRT about 480 m (LTA target 2030) and Tavistock MRT about 580 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,140 m; Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 1,700 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 91 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 511 resales (636 purchases); new sales were 19.7% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 511 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 91 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 511 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 548 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.8%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
